title: Weather presentation — cloud-sourced precip, phase motion, patchy snow, weather fog (C-020 G6-G9)
simLoop: None — pure observer (T-006). C-020's global cloudWater/precipPhase delivery model is unchanged; no WorldState field added, no cell targeting.
gameLoop: Heavier rain regimes visibly release from more/larger clouds at once instead of one wider faucet plane; rain reads as fast wind-sheared fall and snow as slow tumbling drift; snow collects unevenly, more in flat/shaded hollows than on exposed slopes; haze thickens during an active spell and clears on a dry day.
notebookSeed: The clouds that carried the storm let it go directly beneath them; the drifts settled thickest where the ground stayed flat and shaded.
